title: docker: Dockerfile, Caddyfile, compose, backup script, README
test_cmd: bash -n scripts/backup.sh && python3 -c "import yaml,sys; d=yaml.safe_load(open('docker-compose.yml')); assert set(d['services'])>={'db','migrate','api','engine','caddy'}, d['services'].keys(); print('compose ok', sorted(d['services']))"
criteria:
Write the deployment files exactly per BUILD.md T08.
- docker/Dockerfile: FROM python:3.12-slim; copy the uv binary with `COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /usr/local/bin/uv`; WORKDIR /app; copy pyproject.toml, uv.lock, alembic.ini, README.md and the realm/ package; run `uv sync --frozen --no-dev`; create and switch to a non-root user (e.g. `realm`); ENV PATH=/app/.venv/bin:$PATH; default CMD ["realm", "api"]. Do not copy tests/ or web/ (Caddy serves web/ from a volume).
- docker/Caddyfile: site `:80`; `handle /api/*` and `handle /ws` -> reverse_proxy api:8000; every other path -> `root * /srv/web` + `file_server`; enable `encode gzip`.
- docker-compose.yml (Compose v2, no `version:` key): services `db` (image postgres:16, env POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD/POSTGRES_DB all `realm`, named volume `pgdata` mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data, healthcheck `pg_isready -U realm -d realm`, restart unless-stopped), `migrate` (build from docker/Dockerfile with context ., command ["realm","migrate"], env_file .env, depends_on db service_healthy, restart "no"), `api` (same build image, command ["realm","api"], env_file .env, depends_on migrate service_completed_successfully, restart unless-stopped, expose 8000), `engine` (command ["realm","engine"], same dependencies/restart), `bots` (the whole service block present but COMMENTED OUT with a note that it arrives in Phase 1), `caddy` (image caddy:2, ports "8080:80", volumes ./docker/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro and ./web:/srv/web:ro, depends_on api, restart unless-stopped). Share the build via a YAML anchor or give each service `build: {context: ., dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile}` plus `image: realm:latest`.
- scripts/backup.sh (bash, `set -euo pipefail`, executable shebang `#!/usr/bin/env bash`): cd to the repo root (dirname of the script/..), mkdir -p backups, run `docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U realm realm | gzip > backups/realm-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).sql.gz`, then keep only the 14 newest files `backups/realm-*.sql.gz` (portable on macOS and Linux: no `xargs -r`; use a `ls -1t ... | tail -n +15 | while read -r f; do rm -f "$f"; done` loop), and a comment block with an example crontab line that runs it daily at 03:00.
- README.md (Thai, markdown, headings): what the game is (2 lines); requirements (Docker with Compose v2); install steps: `cp .env.example .env`, `docker compose up -d`; create a world: `docker compose exec api realm new-world --speed 1 --name ผู้เล่น --tribe stonehold --bots 30 --seed 42` (note: bots arrive in Phase 1, currently 0 are created); open `http://<server-ip>:8080`; remote access via Tailscale (install Tailscale on server and phone, open `http://<tailscale-ip>:8080`, never expose port 8080 to the internet because there is no login); pause/resume with `docker compose exec api realm pause` / `realm resume`; run the tests (`docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d` then `uv sync` and `uv run pytest -q`, lint with `uv run ruff check .`); backups (`./scripts/backup.sh`, crontab example) and restore (stop engine and api, `gunzip -c backups/<file>.sql.gz | docker compose exec -T db psql -U realm realm` into an empty database, then start again); a short project layout section.
notes:
- This task only writes files; do NOT run docker (the lead verifies it).
- Thai text must be exact and simple; copy these words as written: 'ผู้เล่น', 'หมู่บ้าน', 'เริ่มเกม', 'สำรองข้อมูล', 'กู้คืนข้อมูล', 'ติดตั้ง', 'เข้าเว็บ', 'หยุดเกม', 'เล่นต่อ'. Double-check tone marks letter by letter (common mistakes: บ่าน for บ้าน, ท่ี for ที่, doubled marks).
- Keep the README under ~120 lines.
- Make scripts/backup.sh executable-ready (the lead runs chmod +x).
